jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description Data Engineer “The Company does not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S.” About Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc. At SBH, our purpose is to inspire a more colorful, confident, and welcoming world. We are the leader in professional hair color, selling and distributing professional beauty supplies across 11 countries through our Sally Beauty and Beauty Systems Group businesses. Sally Beauty offers products for hair color, hair care, nails, and skin care to retail customers looking for salon-quality products at a value price. Beauty Systems Group, branded as Cosmo Prof or Armstrong McCall stores, along with its direct sales consultants, sell professionally branded products intended for use and resale by salons to retail consumers. About The Role This is a hybrid position working from our Legacy West Support Center in Plano, Texas. The Data Engineer is responsible for supporting the design, development, and maintenance of enterprise data solutions on the Data Bricks Lake House Platform. This role works closely with senior Data Engineers, Data Architects, Analytics Engineers, and business stakeholders to develop data pipelines, transform and validate data, and support reporting, analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) initiatives. The Data Engineer I will participate in the implementation of modern cloud-based data solutions while developing technical expertise in data engineering best practices. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using the Databricks Lakehouse Platform. Build ETL/ELT processes utilizing Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, and Delta Lake. Design and implement Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold). Develop batch and streaming data ingestion pipelines from enterprise systems, APIs, and cloud platforms. Build reusable data transformation frameworks using PySpark and SQL. Optimize Spark jobs and Delta Lake tables for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. Configure and support Unity Catalog for data governance, security, and lineage. Develop workflows using Databricks Workflows and Jobs. Support Change Data Capture (CDC) and incremental data processing. Build semantic data models supporting reporting, analytics, AI, and machine learning. Implement automated testing, monitoring, and alerting for data pipelines. Create technical documentation, metadata, and operational standards. Research and recommend new technologies and platform enhancements Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Requirement Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical field. 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Software Engineering. 1+ years of hands-on experience with the Databricks Lakehouse Platform. Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Amazon S3, or similar cloud storage platforms. Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (Azure preferred). Experience supporting enterprise analytics platforms such as Power BI. Retail, merchandising, supply chain, or eCommerce experience preferred. Competencies & attributes Databricks Lakehouse Platform Delta Lake and Delta Live Tables (DLT) Unity Catalog Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) ETL/ELT Pipeline Development Data Modeling and Data Warehousing Lakehouse Architecture SQL Development and Performance Optimization Python Programming REST API and Enterprise System Integration Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) or Cloud Object Storage Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform Business Intelligence and Analytics Support Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills Strong Written and Verbal Communication Cross-Functional Collaboration Planning, Organization, and Time Management Results-Oriented with Strong Attention to Detail Working Conditions & Physical Requirements The work environment involves everyday risks or discomforts which require normal safety precautions typical of such places as offices, meeting and training rooms, retail stores, and residences or commercial vehicles, e.g., use of safe work practices with office equipment, avoidance of trips and falls, observance of fire regulations and traffic signals, etc. The work area is adequately lighted, heated, and ventilated. The work is sedentary. Typically, the employee may sit comfortably to do the work. However, there may be some walking; standing; bending; carrying of light items such as papers, files, books, small parts; using a keyboard, driving an automobile, etc. No special physical demands are required to perform the work. Benefits We offer a competitive salary and outstanding benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life Insurance, paid vacation and sick days, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement and 401(k) with company match. In addition, associates of SBH may take advantage of our in-house salon with complementary services and a varied selection of food options at our corporate campus. Also, featured at our corporate campus, is both a Sally Beauty and CosmoProf Professional onsite store, where associates enjoy a great merchandise discount!

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description Roles & Responsibilities We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer with strong expertise in Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, and AWS to support enterprise data modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing scalable data pipelines, data models, and reusable data products. Experience with Snowflake CoCo and modern cloud data engineering practices is highly desirable. Design, develop, and maintain scalable ELT/ETL pipelines using Snowflake and dbt. Build enterprise-grade data models supporting analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives. Perform source-to-target mapping and implement data transformation frameworks. Develop and optimize Snowflake databases, schemas, and data pipelines. Leverage Snowflake CoCo capabilities to accelerate data engineering activities. Implement data quality controls, reconciliation processes, and monitoring frameworks. Optimize query performance, warehouse utilization, and overall platform efficiency. Collaborate with architects, business stakeholders, and analytics teams to deliver trusted data products. Support DataOps and CI/CD practices for data engineering solutions. Ensure compliance with security, governance, and data management standards. Cloud Technologies AWS (Preferred) S3 Lambda Cloud-native Data Services Data Engineering Data Warehousing ETL / ELT Development Data Modeling Source-to-Target Mapping Data Quality & Reconciliation Performance Tuning Snowflake Expertise Snowpipe Streams & Tasks Data Sharing Role-Based Security Query Optimization Warehouse Management Salary Range: $130,000 to $145,000 per year Qualifications: BACHELOR OF COMPUTER SCIENCE

jobs.title: F-35 Fleet Tracking Engineer II (Reporting & Data Analyst)
jobs.description: Job Description The BAE Systems F-35 Lightning II program has an exciting opportunity for an F-35 Fleet Tracking engineer responsible for the delivery of quarterly Individual Aircraft Tracking and Loads/Environment Spectra Survey reports. Our work is critical to the continued success of the F-35 program and is highly visible to our Lockheed Martin partners and military operators. The US Structures and Prognostics Health Management (SPHM) team is comprised of over fifteen engineers with diverse technical backgrounds directly interfacing with our UK-based counterparts as well as our Lockheed Martin customer. The successful candidate will take ownership of various data analysis, reporting, and development activities to facilitate the creation of quarterly reports of the F-35 fleet to ensure that data is accurately consumed, processed, and aggregated for reporting purposes. A collaborative, flexible, and critical mind, along with exceptional communication skills are essential elements for this role. Key Responsibilities Each quarter: One month is spent gathering, analyzing data, and producing a report Two months are spent working on improving our automation and reporting tools Produce quarterly reports via various automation tools and Microsoft Office with high level of attention to detail Develop automation tools to aid in the creation of quarterly reports Assist in transition/development of tools from older software to new python based software Gain a complete understanding of internal processes, tools, and standards Understand, manipulate, and summarize large amounts of F-35 structures data Develop solutions to identify trends and data anomalies with the aid of senior teammates Communicate issues and concerns to team leadership in a clear and concise manner Prioritize assigned tasks in order to accomplish the required objectives Work independently and take responsibility for the quality of work output Conduct peer review of reporting deliverables to ensure the highest quality product Flexibly respond to ad-hoc customer data requests Provide independent recommendations for task expansion, increased efficiency, and performance improvement Required Education, Experience, & Skills Bachelors Degree or equivalent Aerospace preferred with experience in structures Experience with Python development Experience with an Agile development methodology Experience with Atlassian or equivalent Confluence, Jira, Bitbucket Comprehensive knowledge of Microsoft Office Tools Excel Pivot tables & lookups Macros (VBA) Demonstrable experience in manipulating and summarizing data at scale Experience with relational databases & SQL Please note that pursuant to a government contract, this specific position requires US citizenship status. Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills Experience in effectively working independently while in a remote environment Experience with Linux command line Pay Information Full-Time Salary Range: $72150 - $122655 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. About BAE Systems Intelligence & Security BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Intelligence & Security (I&S), based in McLean, Virginia, designs and delivers advanced defense, intelligence, and security solutions that support the important missions of our customers. Our pride and dedication shows in everything we do—from intelligence analysis, cyber operations and IT expertise to systems development, systems integration, and operations and maintenance services. Knowing that our work enables the U.S. military and government to recognize, manage and defeat threats inspires us to push ourselves and our technologies to new levels. This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.title: Professional, ABF IMS Business Intelligence Associate
jobs.description: Company Overview KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. K-star Investment Services Overview K-Star Asset Management LLC ("K-Star") was formed in 2022 and is a wholly owned subsidiary of KKR. K- Star Investment Services supports the risk management of its Asset-Based Finance investments, asset management, securities investing, and client experience for its Real Estate Credit franchise as both verticals continue to scale. The K-Star team includes industry specialists to oversee residential mortgage investments, consumer finance investments, special servicing, stabilized and transitional loan asset management across many KKR investment portfolios. Position Summary K-Star is seeking a Residential Mortgage / Consumer Loan Data Analytics Associate to join its ABF Investment Services Team focusing on Asset-Based Finance investments. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wishes to build a career in investment operations at a reputable buy-side firm. The role is based in Dallas and collaborates regularly with the deal team at KKR. The ideal candidate will have 3-5 years of relevant experience at a financial institution with exposure to residential mortgage and/or consumer data analytics. The position will support the Asset-Based Finance desk and will work directly with the investment team to assist with data analysis and management related to its existing $30bn portfolio. The role requires constant communication with the deal team and various stakeholders and business groups, so strong communication and relationship-building skills are essential. We are passionate about operational excellence and providing our investment and business operations colleagues the ability to seamlessly execute liquid and private credit investments around the globe. We are committed to continuous improvement, both in the operations we perform and in the environment in which we work. We work in collaborative teams within the context and support of a large, global investment firm. We can offer challenging and rewarding work and opportunities for career advancement and learning in both the business and operational spheres. Responsibilities Support the Asset-Based Finance group with data management related to residential and consumer loans Design and develop automated end-to-end pipelines to ingest, normalize, and standardize data. Maintain centralized databases in Snowflake, using SQL to transform or analyze data and create downstream reporting and hosting the data in a centralized database (Snowflake) for easy access Synthesize multiple data sources to produce meaningful reporting and analytics with actionable insights for Senior Leadership and other stakeholders Serve as primary liaison between business stakeholders and engineering teams, either as the engineer building out the project or assisting our technology team with requirements and clear plans to reduce turnaround time QUALIFCATIONS Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree 3-5 years of experience in Data Analytics within the Financial Services industry with exposure to residential / consumer data Advanced knowledge of MS suite, SQL, and Python. Other programming languages are a plus Strong personal initiative, exceptional organization and attention to detail, and ability to learn quickly A track record in accuracy and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced, growing work environment with high expectations Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills Team-oriented with strong integrity and professionalism Experience and track record in process improvement and automation KKR is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by applicable law. KKR is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: As a member of the Institutional Research team, the Data Analyst position supports institutional decision-making by assisting with data management, data quality, and data literacy efforts across the College. Under the direction of the Director of Institutional Research, this position will consult with functional and academic offices to identify their data and reporting needs, then coordinate the transformation, storage, and management of the data using a variety of tools and database systems with special emphasis on delivering high-quality reports and information to stakeholders to support operations and decision-making. Consult with functional and academic offices to identify data sources and reporting needs. Work with subject matter experts to document metadata for data systems, elements, and reports. Translate functional and academic data needs into technical specifications. Assist with the design and creation of databases to store and manage information. Assist with data cleaning, transformation, storage, and validation. Identify data quality metrics and conduct regular data quality audits. Assist with the creation of data extracts and dashboards to support reporting requirements. Recommend improvements to data management policies and standards. Build and maintain effective working relationships with other offices on campus. Assist with the creation and maintenance of procedural documentation. Perform other duties related to data management and institutional research as assigned. COMPETENCIES Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Collaboration/Teamwork, Computer Software Skills, Customer Service, Data Analysis, Decision-making, Internet Research, Interpersonal Skills, Math Skills, Multi-tasking, Written Communication, Organizational Skills, Problem-solving, Project Management, Public Speaking, Time Management, Typing/Word Processing Supervisory Responsibilities Individual Contributor Work Environment: Work is rarely required outside of normal business hours Physical Demands: Sitting, walking, standing, repetitive motion, primarily computer-related tasks Travel Required: Yes – Minimal If travel is required, the candidate must have and maintain a current, valid Texas driver’s license and an acceptable driving record. Required Education Bachelor’s Degree in a related field Required Experience Two years of working with databases, creating reports, analytics, or other related experience An equivalent combination of education and experience may be used. Preferred Experience/Skills SQL Ellucian Banner Student Information System/ERP Additional Job-Specific Requirements Must have experience with data extraction and analysis tools. Understand SQL either directly or through a visual builder tool. EXPECTATIONS Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Will have contact – in person, by email, or by phone – with staff, students, and the general public. Must exhibit a sensitivity to and an understanding of the diverse academic, socio-economic, cultural, and ethnic backgrounds of staff and students and to staff and students with disabilities. Regular and punctual attendance is an essential function of each employee. NOTE: With or without reasonable accommodation, the individual in this position must possess the competencies and must be able to perform the essential functions and duties of the job as described above - including essential tasks requiring specific physical demands.

jobs.title: Google Data Engineer
jobs.description: Role: Data Engineer Who You’ll Work With At Slalom we co-create custom software, data, AI, and cloud products with clients who are ready to accelerate their digital transformation. We're passionate about technology, compelled by its potential as we help create the digital products, experiences, and technology-driven organizations that drive true change. We’re thrilled by the opportunity to build the future we want to see, with anyone willing to join us. Slalom's Google Center of Excellence (COE) is focused on injecting intelligence into products, engineering systems that support learning and insight and creating innovative data products. Within Data Engineering we help customers build world-class products through effective use of: Batch and real-time data engineering, including scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using modern cloud-native architectures. Modern data platforms built on Google Cloud, including data lakes,lakehouses, and enterprise data warehouses. Streaming data platforms for real-time ingestion, event-driven architectures, and analytics. Data integration and orchestration using modern workflow and pipeline automation tools. Data platform modernization and migration, helping clients transition legacy data environments to Google Cloud. AI-ready data foundations, ensuring high-quality, governed, and scalable data to support advanced analytics and generative AI use cases. What You’ll Do Slalom Google Data and AI is comprised of passionate, flexible technologists who love to practice and hone their craft. As tools evolve and technologies emerge, we work to stay in front of innovations in data platform development and delivery. As a Data Engineer in Slalom's Google COE, you will work in collaborative teams to design, build, and modernize enterprise data platforms on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will deliver solutions using BigQuery, Dataplex, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Vertex AI, Looker, and other Google Cloud services. You will help clients migrate and modernize data estates, implement real-time and batch pipelines, enable governed analytics, and accelerate AI-ready data foundations. You will be engaged to participate in design sessions and be responsible for the timely completion of development items assigned to you in a project backlog. *You will work in a hybrid environment, with expectation to be in-person with Slalom teams and clients as needed. *You also must be within commutable distance to one of Slalom's listed office locations. What You’ll Bring You are passionate about Google Cloud and modern data engineering and continuously expand your skills through hands-on delivery, certifications, and collaboration across the Google COE. You enjoy solving complex data challenges and building scalable, secure, cloud-native platforms. Big Data Platforms (Dataproc, Apache Spark) GoogleBigQuery,BigLake, Cloud SQL Python, Java, SQL Firestore, Bigtable, Spanner, MongoDB Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Apache Kafka Managed Airflow,dbt,Dataplex Nice to have Looker, Looker Studio Gemini Enterprise, AI, ML Ops About Us Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all. Compensation and Benefits Slalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.The base salary pay range is $100,000 - $115,000 for Consultant, depending on experience. In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time. EEO and Accommodations Slalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team if you require accommodations during the interview process.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: About RS Group RS is a high-service global product and service solutions provider for industrial customers, enabling them to operate efficiently and sustainably. We operate in 33 markets, stock over 875,000 industrial and specialist products and list an additional five million relevant for our industrial customers, sourced from over 2,500 suppliers. This extensive range supports our customers across the industrial lifecycle of designing, building and maintaining equipment and operations. We enhance their experience through a tailored service model, leveraging our efficient physical, digital and process infrastructure sustainably. We combine a technically led and digitally enabled approach with an exceptional team of experts; ultimately, it’s our people that make the difference. Our purpose, making amazing happen for a better world, reflects our focus on delivering results for people, planet and profit. This role sits at the center of a strategic transformation to modernize sales quoting, pricing, and revenue processes through the implementation of Salesforce Revenue Cloud and related platforms. About The Role Role Purpose The Data Scientist plays a critical role in driving profitable growth by identifying, analyzing, and delivering data-driven insights that optimize margin performance across the organization. This role leverages advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and machine learning techniques to uncover pricing, cost, and product mix opportunities within an industrial and electronics distribution environment. Responsibilities Working closely with pricing, sales, procurement, and finance teams, the Data Scientist translates complex data into actionable recommendations that support strategic decision-making Analyze margin/growth performance across customers, products, suppliers, and channels to identify improvement opportunities Detect margin leakage drivers such as discounting, pricing inconsistencies and cost fluctuations Analyze win/loss data, deal-level performance, and competitive pricing trends Develop predictive models for demand, price elasticity, and customer behavior Apply machine learning techniques to identify cross-sell, upsell, and mix optimization opportunities Aggregate and transform large datasets Sales, Customer, Product, Competitor Provide clear, actionable insights through storytelling (narrative building) Enable self-service analytics for business stakeholders Track and measure realized impact of implemented initiatives Support RS through gaining deep understanding of various areas of the business, bringing fresh ideas and ways of thinking to change strategy and policy Maintain documentation for models, data pipelines, and methodologies Ensure compliance with data governance and internal policies Promote best practices in analytics and data science across the organization How I Make a Difference In This Role You bridge the gap between analytics and business execution by translating complex models into clear, actionable recommendations that sales, pricing, and procurement teams can use in real decisions (e.g., deal pricing, contract negotiations). Candidate Requirements Essential Skills & Experience Python Advanced SQL Advanced statistics and machine learning knowledge Advanced data engineering and feature building Reasonable level of price theory (willingness to pay, share of wallet, elasticity etc) Stakeholder management (simplifying advanced concepts into narratives/visualizations) Strong problem solving Strong ideation Strong interpersonal skills, willing to work in group-projects Desirable Skills & Experience Snowflake/AWS Spark/Databricks ERP/SAP/Salesforce Powerbi Essential Qualifications (Must Be Evidenced At Offer Stage) Bachelor’s degree in a technical or related field or equivalent experience. Equal Employment Opportunity RS Americas is an equal opportunity employer and maintains policies and practices that are designed to prevent and prohibit unlawful discrimination against any qualified employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, ancestry, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, military/veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other unlawful classification to the extent protected by law. This policy of nondiscrimination applies to all employment practices, including hiring, compensation, benefits, promotion, training and termination. Employees who engage in unlawful discrimination will be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination.

We provide extensive opportunities for personal and professional development, building both employee competence and organizational capability to fuel exceptional performance through an inclusive environment both now and in the future. jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Overview This is a full-time, in-person position at MINT's headquarters in downtown Dallas, TX. The Analytics Engineer will report to the VP of Data and Analytics and will assist in turning raw data into valuable information that can be utilized to make decisions and streamline business processes. The ideal candidate will be able to function effectively with limited oversight and a methodical attention to detail. The work will involve communicating with stakeholders, building dimensional data models and analytical reports with dbt (SQL), building automated dashboards, and investigating and fixing any errors. This is a small team, and you will have direct exposure to many different departments at MINT.
